abstract.t:
Each HTTP request has only a single response. This document defines the 209 Multiresponse status code, whose content holds several responses, and the application/http-history media type, which encodes a sequence of responses to one resource over time. With them, a server can send a history of a resource, or a stream of its changes, in one response, which caches can store piece by piece.
This document is one of the Braid-HTTP extensions, which work alone or together; together they make HTTP a state synchronization protocol.
